source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = set(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    for color in colors:
        full_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == color for v in grid[r])]
        if not full_rows:
            continue
        for r, row in enumerate(grid):
            if row[0] != color or all(v == color for v in row):
                continue
            end = 0
            while end < w and row[end] == color:
                end += 1
            if end < w and all(v != color for v in row[end:]):
                for c in range(end, w):
                    out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
